record.body:
This closing record indexes the Signature biofonics edition and points forward. The Signature edition holds sixteen records: a Signature introduction, a dawn chorus model, a three-layer model, a songbird synthesizer design, a frog chorus synthesizer design, an insect call synthesizer design, a bat pulse model, a whale song model, an infrasound rumble model, an acoustic niche planner, a soundscape index calculator design, a field recorder design, a quiet-zone model, a reef chorus model, a monitoring network design, and this index. Every record is labelled Signature in its title and body, every synthesised call is labelled SIMULATED, and no Signature record is presented as field data. The companion Signature soundscapes edition covers whole virtual soundscapes habitat by habitat, and the existing live pairs on animal sounds, whale song archives, and adaptive soundscape composition are cross-linked from here, never rebuilt. Future Signature waves, listed here as planned and not as delivered, include a Signature bird-song library, a Signature marine-call library, and a Signature insect-sound library.

Science proof

Science proof: an index is verified by checking it against the records it lists. Every title named in this record appears in this edition with the stated layer coverage, ladder rank, and demo, and every cross-link named points to an existing live pair or to the companion pair in this suite. The index makes no claim about unbuilt waves beyond listing them as planned, so its claims are checkable from the package itself.

Math proof

Math proof: this edition holds 16 records, split into 6 simple, 5 compounded, and 5 complex records, since 6 + 5 + 5 = 16. The compounded share is 5 / 16 = 31.25 percent, shown as 31.2 percent, and the complex share is the same. The demo prints counts 6, 5, 5, total 16, compounded share 31.2 percent, and complex share 31.2 percent.

Soundscape layer(s)

biophony; geophony; anthrophony

Source

Signature suite plan for this pair, October 2026; record contents of this edition as built

demo.code:
print('Simple records: %d' % 6)
print('Compounded records: %d' % 5)
print('Complex records: %d' % 5)
print('Total records: %d' % (6 + 5 + 5))
print('Compounded share: %.1f percent' % (100.0 * 5 / 16))
print('Complex share: %.1f percent' % (100.0 * 5 / 16))
demo.expected_output:
